name: Zohar canyon (barak9177, CC BY 4.0), SuperSplat collider, rescaled x8
notes: Generated by sim/tools/maps/build_splat_map.mjs --scene canyon from the SuperSplat v1.1 collider ("Zohar Riverbad, Dead sea, Israel" by barak9177 (https://superspl.at/scene/7aa4d3d4), licensed under CC BY 4.0.). Occupancy is conservative at 0.4 units. Cells  are sealed as an altitude geofence (a flight rule, not scanned geometry). Scene units x8, treated as metres: chosen by eye with a correctly scaled drone in a lower channel; there the narrowest pinch is about 6 m. The collider's native 0.05-unit voxels become 0.4 m, so the grid cell is 0.4. The crop top (y = 20, the earlier 2.5-unit ceiling x8) is the altitude limit that seals the plateaus. Not independently calibrated.

ground.meaning: floor of each column's sky-facing free interval (null = sealed column)
